title: A sum of boundaries of nested sets of finite perimeter with bounded partial masses is integer multiplicity (Simon 6.3.14 (8)–(9), 3.15, Ch. 3, 4.3(‡))
statement: Let n ≥ 1, let U_j ⊆ ℝ^{n+1} (j ∈ ℤ) be Borel sets with U_{j+1} ⊆ U_j, and let X_j ∈ 𝒟_{n+1}(ℝ^{n+1}) with X_j(ω) = ∫_{U_j} ω(x)(e_0, …, e_n) dL^{n+1}(x) for every ω and M(∂X_j) < ∞ for every j. Let T ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^{n+1}) satisfy HasSum (j ↦ ∂X_j(η)) (T(η)) for every η ∈ 𝒟^n(ℝ^{n+1}), and let C ∈ [0, ∞) be such that M(Y) ≤ C for every N ∈ ℕ and every Y ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^{n+1}) with Y(η) = Σ_{j=−N}^{N} ∂X_j(η) for all η. Then T is integer multiplicity.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : ℤ → Set (Euclid (n + 1))) (X : ℤ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid (n + 1))) (n + 1)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid (n + 1))) n) (C : ℝ≥0∞), 1 ≤ n → (∀ j, MeasurableSet (U j)) → (∀ j, U (j + 1) ⊆ U j) → (∀ (j : ℤ) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (n + 1))) (n + 1)), X j ω = ∫ x in U j, (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (n + 1)) (n + 1)) x (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))) → (∀ j, (X j).boundary.mass < ∞) → (∀ η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (n + 1))) n, HasSum (fun j => (X j).boundary η) (T η)) → C < ∞ → (∀ (N : ℕ) (Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid (n + 1))) n), (∀ η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (n + 1))) n, Y η = ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc (-(N : ℤ)) N, (X j).boundary η) → Y.mass ≤ C) → IsIntegerMultiplicity T
